slides.sub: Obsidian keeps your notes as plain files on your device.

slides.body:
**What it does:**
Keeps your notes as plain files on your device, linked together.

**How you use it:**
Link ideas, tag them, and explore the connections in a graph view.

**Why designers care:**
Research, references and ideas in one searchable place.
